assets.name: Tiệm mèo
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production PNG photobooth overlay for an image compositor, NOT a mockup.
Create ONE beautifully art-directed square 1024x1024 photobooth frame, front-on, edge-to-edge. Premium collectible Korean photo-booth stationery: sophisticated handmade collage, tactile paper, lovingly detailed illustrated stickers, exquisite small material details. It must feel designed by an excellent stationery illustrator, never like clipart circles or basic computer-drawn shapes.
CRITICAL FUNCTIONAL LAYOUT: four large empty photo windows in a 2 by 2 grid. Approximate pixel rectangles on a 1024 square: top left x80 y64 width416 height392; top right x528 y64 width416 height392; bottom left x80 y488 width416 height392; bottom right x528 y488 width416 height392. Keep all four windows equal, aligned, nearly square with subtly rounded corners. These four windows must be genuinely transparent alpha holes. All surrounding paper including the central horizontal and vertical gutters is opaque. Fill the outside edges of the canvas with the paper frame, no floating product and no external background.
Place rich illustrations and embellishments in the outer margins and bottom band, with a few small die-cut decorations overlapping only the corners of photo openings. Keep the large central areas of every photo hole unobstructed. Generous breathing room, thoughtful asymmetry and balanced clusters; intricate work up close, readable silhouette at thumbnail size.
No people, no photographs inside holes, no placeholder colors, no checkerboard painted into holes. No words, letters, numbers, captions, logos or watermarks. Do not show multiple designs, a contact sheet, a phone, a poster mockup or a perspective product shot.

ART DIRECTION:
Warm ivory and pale apricot paper, delicate caramel pencil lines. Two exquisitely illustrated fluffy cream kittens with blush cheeks, one curled sleeping beside a tiny teacup in the bottom band, the other peeking from a top corner. Tiny embossed paw prints, charming mini butter-cookie and cream-flower stickers, small gingham fabric scraps and thin apricot ribbon tabs. Soft watercolor and colored-pencil texture, softly raised die-cut edges, restrained warm shadows. Elegant cozy cat cafe scrapbook, not childish flat vector art.
The inside of each photo window is completely empty, clean uniform alpha=0 across its entire interior. No dust, cloud effects, painted transparent-looking pattern or colored fringe in the holes.
